title: prd-distance contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-535). The SHAPE of the PRD-satisfaction-greedy drain-ordering signal that `faff prdr distance` PRODUCES and `faff contract prd-distance` VALIDATES (consumer-side conformance, mirroring prd-coverage / prdr-yagni). One `entries` list of per-sibling remainders, each classified onto the coarse four-class steps-remaining ladder (met 0 / unverified 1 / unmet 2 / uncovered 3 — lower class_rank = nearer to advancing the parent PRD), plus a `prd_satisfied` echo of the coverage roll-up (observability, NOT a gate). It is NOT consumed by any gate: it is a pure, PRD-scoped INPUT the methodology composes as a within-band ordering tiebreaker (gateway Standard-envelope floor: distance never crosses human-set priority bands; absent ⇒ every ordering output byte-identical). NO safe coerce target — faff's own producer emits it, so a malformed extraction is a fail-loud. Load-bearing invariants (class_rank pinned to distance_class per the ladder; kind === 'goal' ⟺ distance_class === 'uncovered') are enforced in code as conformance violations. `id` / `container` / `dod_verdict` are nullable (goal entries and absent-verdict siblings carry null), so their type is left unconstrained here and pinned in the producer.
